notes: Citizen Personality + Natural Dialogue: Aris, Bex, Cato, Iri, Noma, and Vale now have distinct stable personality tendencies and conversational voices. Personality may bias preferences, tone, curiosity, caution, and cooperation, but never grants authority, rank, command rights, extra capability, or extra knowledge. Simulation, Memory, and physical authority rules are unchanged.
